title: Gate-rejected transfer: real_matbench_phonons to real_matbench_dielectric
summary: The raw route had composite delta +1.0506 on held-out seeds, but its 95% CI [-4.2766, +6.3779] crossed zero. Calibration rejected it and deployed the exact matched target-only LLM.
content: Reusable lesson: do not force a source-derived semantic policy when every evidence mode fails calibration. Preserve the target-only fallback and improve the reaction representation before retrying.
